audit: 2026-09-08 scheduled remote agent p5: 50 Qs in one batch across all four topics (Psychiatry 15, Paediatrics 13, Obstetrics and Gynaecology 12, Medicine 10), published as ten 5-question files to stay inside the tool payload limit. Per-question deficit selection was run on the active L3 to L5 tier, following the p3 and p4 precedent, because the closed legacy L1 and L2 inventory of about 25 to 30 per cent per topic makes the whole-topic denominator unreachable. Every topic entered the run at 49.3 to 49.4 per cent L3, 44.3 to 44.4 per cent L4 and 6.2 to 6.3 per cent L5, so L5 again sat above its 5 per cent target in all four topics and none was generated; the greedy per-question walk produced 26 L3 and 24 L4 and zero L1 or L2, and all four topics finish at 49.4 per cent L3, 44.4 per cent L4 and 6.2 per cent L5. Correct-letter distribution A10 B10 C10 D10 E10; worst option length parity 1.28 across all 50; zero non-ASCII characters, zero em-dashes and zero banned tokens; every rationale carries an inline source and every source_ref matches a label in that question sources array; no stem or id duplicates against the existing bank; every stem positions the candidate as the treating doctor; no lead-in guideline leaks, no pertinent-negative parentheticals in any correct option and no follow local guidelines non-options; stems run 138 to 188 words with paragraph breaks and all tags are drawn from the existing vocabulary. Cluster selection this run was driven by an explicit coverage sweep of the 5439 existing subtopic_detail strings: eleven initially planned clusters were discarded as near-duplicates of existing items and replaced with ground the bank had not touched.
